in_arabic.name: جدالله
in_arabic.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'j-d-l', meaning 'to be heavy' or 'weighty' in a metaphorical sense. It can be translated to English as 'weighty' or 'significant'.

in_urdu.name: جداللہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: زائدہ (zā'idah) in Urdu means 'excessive', 'additional', or 'abundant'. The name 'jadallah' can be translated to Urdu as 'zā'idah-Allāh', meaning 'God of the excessive' or 'God of abundance'.

in_hindi.name: जदल्लाह
in_hindi.long_meaning: गुणनाक (guṇanāk) in Hindi means 'rich', 'powerful', or 'wealthy'. The name 'jadallah' can be translated to Hindi as 'guṇanāk-Allāh', meaning 'God of wealth' or 'God of power'.

in_pashto.name: جدالله
in_pashto.long_meaning: دانش (dānsh) in Pashto means 'knowledge', 'wisdom', or 'intelligence'. The name 'jadallah' can be translated to Pashto as 'dānsh-Allāh', meaning 'God of knowledge' or 'God of wisdom'.
